business_problem: Managing a channel-less go-to-market strategy is the customer expectation, but it can be an operational nightmare to execute. With Sitecore, brands get intelligent content orchestration that enables the design, development, and delivery of content that converts across any channel. The powerful combination of Sitecore XM Cloud’s modern CMS, Sitecore Content Hub’s powerful Digital Asset Management (DAM), and Sitecore OrderCloud’s headless eCommerce engine enables brands to optimize content velocity, orchestrate their digital experiences, and monetize everything, everywhere.
